scope: Read-only independent review of D's frozen eight-file installed TLS/private-file admission slice

sourceReview.result: Installed loading binds release, full scope, profile, endpoint, DNS, CA root, leaf pin, matching private key and exact secure factory/Compose bytes. Held private-file reads preserve owner/mode/link/identity/change-time and descriptor access checks. Missing TLS enrollment and plaintext do not regenerate or fallback. Policy copies avoid caller mutation.
sourceReview.limits: Source closure only. No source edits, test reruns, provider calls, Docker operations or native execution by these reviewers.

rawInspection.inspector: Plato verified raw event counts; main independently verified the artifact SHA-256 values and read the production admission paths.

evidenceFinding.problem: The supplied manifest and directory do not record invocation arguments or exit codes. Raw passing JSON events alone do not prove the claimed -race flag, and empty vet output alone does not prove a successful vet exit.
evidenceFinding.required: Link preserved command and exit records or collect an explicitly identified new verification run. Do not infer missing arguments or relabel source history.

limits: This review does not prove real Docker injection or NATS credential admission through the installed client.
Native Darwin descriptor ACL/mount behavior and protected execution require actual qualified CGO1 execution.
Source review, worker completion and passing raw entries are not phase acceptance.
